layout_notes: The guide is organised by chapter (अध्याय). A chapter starts with an opener page. In Classes 1 and 2 it has a tab 'अध्याय N' above a dark band with the chapter title, then a large coloured illustration. In Class 3 it has no tab and no chapter number: a line drawing of a teacher at a blank board, with the chapter title in large orange letters below it. Every opener then has a yellow label 'दक्षताएँ :' above an orange box listing the chapter's competencies. That page is page_kind 'unit_opener': set header = chapter title, and put the 'दक्षताएँ' box in 'shared' (heading = the label exactly as printed, bullet items) together with one 'figure' item for the illustration.

Lesson-plan pages: an orange band with the chapter title, then a grey band 'Lesson Plan … Class N'. Set header = the chapter title. Ignore the 'Teaching / Learning Materials' picture strip and the 'Chapter QR Code' box (do not transcribe them).

Below that, the page is divided into 2 or 3 COLUMNS. Each column is one teaching unit. Each column starts with a yellow box listing the unit's objectives (bullets) and a calendar badge 'Day a-b' (or 'Day a'). Key 'days' = the badge text after 'Day', exactly as printed, e.g. '1-2'. Key 'chapter' = the chapter title printed in the orange band at the top of the page. The yellow-box bullets go into the unit's 'intro'.

Full-width orange bars 'ब्लॉक N – name' are level-1 sections (number 'N', heading = the name after the dash, e.g. 'मौखिक गणित बातचीत'). Full-width dark-grey bars with a staircase icon are level-2 sections (number null, heading = the bar text). Because these bars span all columns, repeat them inside every column's unit, and put under each only that column's own text.

When a page starts with column text BEFORE any bar (the continuation of a block from the previous page), put that text in a section with the same number/heading as the last block/sub-step of the previous page if you can see it is a continuation, otherwise number null and heading null; set continues_from_previous_page true.
Within a column: paragraphs are 'text' items, lines with •, – or ‣ markers are 'bullet' items. Keep textbook page references exactly ('पृष्ठ संख्या 2').

Pages with the academic plan table ('अकादमिक प्लान'), competency tables, or teaching-strategy tables are page_kind 'plan'. Assessment/worksheet pages are 'assessment'. Introductory pages are 'front_matter'.
